newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 106.9 Jan 10 wk.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 106.9 Jan 10 wk.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) weekly future inflation gauge (FIG) fell to 106.9 in the week ended January 10, down from a revised 107.2 the prior week, ECRI said.
"The gauge is down slightly from an upwardly revised 107.2 for the previous week, which represents a 36-week high," ECRI said.
Although the growth rates of real estate loans fell modestly, the industrial materials prices increased to a 17-week high, it said.

"Labor markets clearly continue to be tight ... It will be important to watch for signs of any emerging consensus about rising inflation pressures among the FIG components related and unrelated to labor markets," ECRI added.
